title: Unified design pass for all handler-derived fields (data_quality / entry_type / reset_type / etc)
description: Multiple handler-derived archive fields (data_quality / entry_type / reset_type / amount / balance_after / actual_bar_count) need a unified design pass before T14b PaperV2ArchiveHandler implementation can be code-reviewed. Decisions required per field: derivation source (which source columns), derivation rules (mapping tables / formulas), null handling (when source incomplete), test fixtures. Without this design pass, T14b would re-derive ad-hoc per-field which risks inconsistency and duplicate review burden. Umbrella issue covering BUG-006 / BUG-007 / BUG-008.
